items.title: Milton Batiste Interview, 1997-02-05
items.q: I remember Senegal played with Smiley with us for a while. He had a drummer. It looked like it was double Johnny.

ctx.x: Smiley was a hell of a blues singer, man. And I forget all the people that really we played with Smiley. It was older musicians. I just can't remember. I remember Senegal played with Smiley with us for a while. He had a drummer. It looked like it was double Johnny. Boy, he was a strong little fella. And I can't remember his name. But we had good times with Smiley. We played with Smiley. And then a little guy came out of Mississippi. From Natchez. His name was Luke. We called him Jupe. Jupe. He played harmonica.…
